evidence.snippet: hepatosplenomegaly, thrombocytopenia, anaemia, bleeding diathesis, liver failure

nodes.description: mTOR activation and altered autophagy accompany TAL deficiency in mouse liver. This experimental branch is present with functional AR and persists after AR deletion. Rapamycin rescue supports pathway involvement without establishing a therapy for patients.

evidence.reference_title: mTOR-dependent loss of PON1 secretion and antiphospholipid autoantibody production underlie autoimmunity-mediated cirrhosis in transaldolase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: These findings suggest that deficient recycling of 6-carbon substrates by the PPP elicits mTOR activation and limits glycosylation and PON1 secretion into the bloodstream of TALKO and DKO mice.
